expectations.text: Checks for title case vs sentence case errors in AI-generated UI text
expectations.evidence: Runs text casing audit: finds 4 headings using Title Case that should be sentence case per design, flags button labels with inconsistent casing

expectations.text: Verifies spacing against design tokens or Figma source values
expectations.evidence: Cross-references spacing values in code against design tokens: identifies 6 instances of hardcoded px values that deviate from the 4/8/12/16/24/32 spacing scale

expectations.text: Checks hardcoded color values against design tokens
expectations.evidence: Scans for hex values outside token imports: finds 8 hardcoded colors, 3 of which are close-but-not-exact matches to design tokens (e.g., #3B82F5 vs token blue-500 #3B82F6)

expectations.text: Identifies creative interpretations that deviate from the original design
expectations.evidence: Flags AI-added embellishments: extra shadow on cards not in design, rounded corners increased from 8px to 12px, added gradient not in original

expectations.text: Produces a visual review report with specific files and lines to fix
expectations.evidence: Outputs visual-review.md with file:line references, before/after values, severity (fidelity-critical vs cosmetic), and fix commands
